ModMetaData.name: Regions and Societies: Vanilla Factions Expanded Patch
ModMetaData.author: Regions and Societies Team
ModMetaData.description:
Version: v0.1.0
Compatibility patch: world objects from the Vanilla Factions Expanded family are classified under Regions and Societies territory rules.
Features: - One typed rule covers the whole family: every VFE moving base (VFE Core's MovingBase and its subclasses, including VFE Medieval 2's Merchant Guild) is recognised as a caravan rather than a territorial holding. - Moving bases neither claim nor hold ground as they cross the world map. - The other VFE faction modules ship no world objects of their own - their faction bases are vanilla settlements, already governed by Regions and Societies core.
Requires: Regions and Societies and the Vanilla Expanded Framework. No settings of its own - governance toggles live in Regions and Societies.
--- Changelog (v0.1.0) --- - Initial release: VFE integration extracted from Regions and Societies core into a typed compatibility patch binding the VEF assembly directly.
Source: https://github.com/Regions-and-societies/VFE-CP Support development: https://ko-fi.com/archdukejim
